# nico_expected_rack (Data Source)

Expected Rack identifies a Rack that is expected to be discovered at a Site. Infrastructure Providers can pre-register Expected Racks with an operator-supplied rack identifier and a Rack Profile reference to help with Rack discovery and ingestion. Chassis identity and physical location information are conveyed via well-known label keys (`chassis.manufacturer`, `chassis.serial-number`, `chassis.model`, `location.region`, `location.datacenter`, `location.room`, `location.position`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_expected_rack" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "expected_rack_name" {
  value = data.nico_expected_rack.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site to filter Expected Racks by

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the Expected Rack was created
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the Expected Rack
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined key-value pairs for organizing and categorizing Expected Racks. Well-known keys (`chassis.*`, `location.*`) are used to convey chassis identity and physical location.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Expected Rack
- `rack_id` (String) Operator-supplied identifier for the rack (string, not UUID). Unique within a Site.
- `rack_profile_id` (String) Identifier of the Rack Profile this rack conforms to
- `updated` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the Expected Rack was last updated
